title: Slash and load
vo: When the dough is ready, turn it out of the bowl onto a sheet of baking paper. Slash the top once, about 1 centimetre deep, with a razor or a sharp knife. With oven gloves on, take out the hot pot and lift off the lid. Lower the dough in by the paper.
voUS: When the dough is ready, turn it out of the bowl onto a sheet of baking paper. Slash the top once, about three-eighths of an inch deep, with a razor or a sharp knife. With oven gloves on, take out the hot pot and lift off the lid. Lower the dough in by the paper.
cap: Turn the dough out onto baking paper.
Slash the top once, about 1 cm deep.
With oven gloves, take out the hot pot and lift off the lid.
Lower the dough in by the paper.
capUS: Turn the dough out onto baking paper.
Slash the top once, about ⅜ inch deep.
With oven gloves, take out the hot pot and lift off the lid.
Lower the dough in by the paper.
